bio.text: Pramila Jayapal was elected to the U.S. House of Representatives in 2016 and represents Washington's 7th District.

Before holding elected office she worked at the nonprofit Program for Appropriate Technology in Health (PATH) and spent 12 years as founder and executive director of OneAmerica, an immigrant advocacy organization.
She was born in India, came to the United States at 16 to attend Georgetown University, and later received an MBA from Northwestern University.
